quote: Each entry in this dataset may involve multiple edits and contain multi-hop reasoning questions that require reasoning from 2 to 4 hops to answer correctly
outputs: Model responses to prompts testing factual accuracy and reasoning

quote: We utilize three metrics on this dataset: Efficacy Score, measuring the success rate of edits directly; Paraphrase Score, indicating the model's ability to accurately recall edited knowledge in paraphrased forms; and Neighborhood Score, assessing whether irrelevant knowledge in the LLM is disturbed

We utilize three widely-used metrics, Efficacy Score, Paraphrase Score, and Neighborhood Score to evaluate all editors on COUNTERFACT dataset, and use Portability Score on COUNTERFACTPLUS dataset. ... The harmonic mean of four metrics, Editing Score, to evaluate each editor's overall capabilities.

We adopt three widely-used metrics, Efficacy Score, Paraphrase Score, and Neighborhood Score to evaluate all editors on COUNTERFACT dataset, and use Portability Score on COUNTERFACTPLUS dataset. We utilize the harmonic mean of four metrics, Editing Score, to evaluate each editor's overall capabilities.
